author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A body was found in the Merrimack River in Bedford on Sunday afternoon, according to WGME. Authorities recovered the person from the water at about 3:30 p.m. after a report of someone in the river.

Officials said the person may have been in the water for an extended period. The identity was being withheld while investigators worked to notify relatives. An autopsy was scheduled to help determine the cause and manner of death.

The death was not believed to be suspicious, according to the report, and officials said there was no indication of a continuing public threat. The discovery brought emergency crews to the Bedford section of the river as investigators began collecting information about when and how the person entered the water.
Investigators did not immediately release details about the person’s age, possible connection to Bedford, or the circumstances leading up to the recovery.
dek: Authorities recovered a body from the Merrimack River in Bedford, and officials said the death was not believed to be suspicious.
headline: Body found in Merrimack River in Bedford, New Hampshire
